prompt:
Work from the spatial puzzle shown in the image: an outline-style reference cube, three opposite-face hint pairs, and six labeled option cubes underneath. Choose the correct labeled option cube. Which option cannot be a view of the same cube? Answer with the option letter.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence requirement: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly one bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] for the correct option panel.
Answer format: set "answer" to the exact option letter of the correct image option.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[668,638,812,824]],"answer":"E"}
